articles.summary: In the dose optimization stage of the randomized Phase 2 trial (Duravelo-2), zelenectide pevedotin at its optimal dose in combination with pembrolizumab demonstrated response rates comparable to published data for standard of care (SOC) in patients with previously untreated metastatic urothelial
articles.title: Bicycle Therapeutics to Present Initial Duravelo-2 Data at 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting
